not_verified.window_ms_and_delay_ms: follow from the taps and the internal rate: window 64 / 2,000 s = 32 ms, delay (64 - 1) / (2 x 2,000) s = 15.75 ms; the world runs the window as a continuous moving average of 32 ms (delay 16.0 ms)
